note: These evaluation artifacts are deliberately NOT committed to git because they total roughly 196 MB (stability_summary.json alone is about 133 MB). This manifest is committed so that a party regenerating the artifacts can confirm they produced the same bytes by comparing this recorded digest and size against their own output. Digest verification is therefore only possible for someone who actually has the artifacts on disk; for a fresh clone every entry here will report as absent. The manifest-to-registry digest cross-check always runs and needs no artifact bytes.
